subject: How studios turn cold leads into paying clients with AI
html:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most fitness studios are sitting on a goldmine they're not touching. The average studio has hundreds of cold leads in their CRM — people who showed interest, opted in, maybe even booked a call — and then went silent. Without a system, those leads just age out. With AI, they become your lowest-cost acquisition channel.

Here's what's working right now: studios are running a reactivation sequence through their CRM that sends a short, personalized message referencing what the lead originally came in for. Not "Hey, we miss you" — something like "Hey {{first_name}}, I remember you were looking at getting stronger before summer. We just opened a few spots for {{business_name}}-area clients — still on your radar?" The AI pulls the context, personalizes the copy, and sends it at the right time. Studios running this are converting 8–15% of dead leads into booked consultations without spending a dollar on new ads.
